audience.accounts: US manufacturers with 200 to 1,000 employees that run NetSuite or Sage Intacct and process more than 2,000 supplier invoices a month

offer.offer: The Month-End Close Benchmark: a 20-minute read-out that shows where a manufacturer's close loses days, built from the buyer's own AP numbers.

message.claim: Brasswick cuts invoice approval from 9 days to 2 for manufacturers on NetSuite or Sage Intacct, so the books close on day 4.
message.proof: Three named manufacturing customers closed on day 4 within two quarters of go-live.

channels.name: LinkedIn ads
channels.reach: Job title and company size targeting on CFO, Controller and AP manager at the account list

channels.name: Webinar
channels.reach: Co-hosted with a NetSuite partner and promoted to the partner's finance list

channels.name: Content syndication
channels.reach: Vendor delivers leads filtered to finance titles at manufacturers of 200 to 1,000 employees

channels.name: SDR outbound
channels.reach: Two SDRs call and email Controllers and AP managers on the account list

tracking: Every lead gets the Salesforce campaign brasswick-q1 on creation. Opportunities created within 90 days of a campaign touch take it as primary campaign source.

risks.risk: The webinar depends on one customer speaker. If she drops out, the webinar has no proof point.
